rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Last lesson: two bishops against the king. One bishop alone cannot mate; the two together can.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The black king is in the corner. Your king guards a7 and b7, and the bishop on e5 guards b8.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Only the check is missing. Look for the long diagonal, from the a8 corner to h1.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! The f3 bishop attacks a8, the e5 bishop guards b8, and the king the rest.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The bishop goes to f3 and checks along the long diagonal. The king has no escape.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d1a4.1: Careful! Without check, the black king has no move at all. That is stalemate, and the game is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.d1a4.2: Let's go back: give check, or the king is left without a move.

rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: in the corner, one bishop gives check and the other takes the square next to it.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now the black king is on b8, next to the corner. The g4 bishop guards c8.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Give a check that leaves him only the corner. In the corner, the mate comes.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Drive the king into the corner with a check, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The f4 bishop gives check, and the black king only has a8.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The bishop goes to f4 and gives check. The black king can only go to a8.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g4f3.1: No check, and the bishop left c8.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g4f3.2: The black king runs to c8, away from the corner.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g4f3.3: Let's go back: first the check, with the other bishop.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not drive the king into the corner. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Drive the king into the corner with a check, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to a8, its only square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Checkmate! The f3 bishop attacks a8, and the f4 bishop guards b8.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show how the bishops push the king, and the danger of stalemate.
rot.demos.parede.e1: Look at the bishops side by side, on d3 and e3. Together, they form a wall of diagonals.
rot.demos.parede.l1: The black king cannot get below this wall. It stays stuck in the upper part.
rot.demos.parede.l2: With the wall ready, your king comes up to help. The bishops move forward together later.
rot.demos.canto.e1: The black king is in the corner. Watch the bishops and the king close the net, without stalemate.
rot.demos.canto.l1: Your king comes close and takes g8 and g7.
rot.demos.canto.l2: The black king only has h7.
rot.demos.canto.l3: Check from the light-squared bishop. The c1 bishop guards h6.
rot.demos.canto.l4: The black king goes back to h8.
rot.demos.canto.l5: Careful here: if the bishop went to h6, it would take g7 without check. No move: stalemate.
rot.demos.canto.l6: So give check along the long diagonal. Checkmate!
rot.demos.canto.l7: Now it's your turn: bishops together, king close, and always count the squares before each move.
rot.pratica.canto.enunciado: Give checkmate. First take c8 with the light-squared bishop, then push the king into the corner.
rot.pratica.canto.fim: Perfect. The two bishops drove the king into the corner and gave mate.
rot.pratica.canto.err.e3f4: Careful! Without check, the black king has no move: stalemate. Try again.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: Start in the center: bishops side by side, king close, and drive the black king to a corner.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Well done. You finished the endgame course!
